title: Loki
summary: Autonomous LAN recon — scan, brute-force, exfiltrate.
description: Loki (LAN Orchestrated Key Infiltrator) is an autonomous network-recon tool: ARP/host discovery, nmap port + vuln scans, credential brute force (FTP/SSH/Telnet/SMB/MySQL/RDP), and file/SQL exfiltration, with an animated themed character on the CardputerZero LCD and a web UI/JSON API over Wi-Fi. On-device menus (F/X navigate, Z/C change, Enter select, Esc back) let you pick a theme, start/pause scanning, and reset hosts/loot/counters. Authorized-use only.
